newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's three main crude ports reopen - officials.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's three main crude ports reopen - officials.

text.p: Mexico crude port Dos Bocas in Tabasco state reopened Tuesday at 1500 local/2100 GMT, port officials said, leaving all three main crude ports open.
Dos Bocas had been closed at 1600/2200 on Monday as wind speeds reached between 40 and 50 km per hour.
A cold front in the Gulf of Mexico shut Dos Bocas and Pajaritos in Veracruz on Monday. Pajaritos reopened at 0800/1400 as wind velocities slowed.
Mexico's largest crude shipping port, Cayo Arcas, did not experience such strong winds and continued shipping, the port captain said.

The Communication and Transport ministry said in its meteorological report at 1500/2100 that the cold front was moving south-southwest, with a new cold front hitting the northern gulf region. Frontera and La Paz ports were reported still shut, with navegation warnings in effect along the Tamaulipas state coast.
